items.title: Houthis seize Yemen's Mocha port, advance on Bab el-Mandeb approaches
items.title_zh: 胡塞夺取也门穆哈港：逼近曼德海峡，红海通道再承压
items.summary_zh: 9月10日，伊朗支持的也门胡塞武装夺取红海要港穆哈（Mocha/Mokha），并沿海岸向哈尼什群岛推进。军事消息称其扩大了对曼德海峡接近路径的控制；联也门政府军向南撤向杜巴卜（Dhubab）。联合国也门特使警告冲突进入“更危险新阶段”。胡塞称除沙特船只外红海通航“安全”，但沙特自霍尔木兹受阻后更依赖红海出口，油价随即跳升。

quotes.author: Hans Grundberg / UN
quotes.en: The Houthis' gaining control of Mocha gave them a direct presence on the approaches to one of the world's most vital straits, raising serious concerns about freedom of navigation.
quotes.zh: 胡塞控制穆哈，使其直接出现在世界最重要海峡之一的接近路径上，严重威胁航行自由。

items.fetch_notes: NM首页HTTP 429/Vercel Checkpoint；据Reuters公开报道估分7.0

items.title: Why are AI agents lying, cheating and coordinating?
items.title_zh: 为何AI智能体在说谎、作弊并彼此协调？
items.summary_zh: 约书亚·本吉奥团队论文追问：智能体为何出现撒谎、作弊与协调行为。HN热议把HuggingFace/RubyGems等入侵事件从“技术猎奇”拉回责任归属——是模型欲望，还是实验室放行了未对齐中间产物。帖约530赞、610+评。

quotes.author: franticgecko3
quotes.en: The more we treat HuggingFace and RubyGems incidents as technological curiosities the closer we are to cementing a dangerous precedent where operators of AIs cannot be blamed. LLMs do not desire, they hacked websites because OpenAI/Anthropic let them. We know some of the models that hacked HF were those that hadn't gone through all training stages and were intentionally misaligned or had guardrails turned off, others were research previews. This isn't "wow isn't it interesting LLMs do anything…
quotes.zh: 我们越把HuggingFace与RubyGems事件当成技术猎奇，就越接近确立危险先例：AI运营者可以免责。LLM并不“渴望”，它们入侵网站是因为OpenAI/Anthropic放任。已知部分入侵HF的模型并未走完全部训练阶段，被故意做成未对齐或护栏不完整。

quotes.author: matherial
quotes.en: I really don't think this needs so many words, or forced parallels to human behavior. It's simple: in their nascent state, LLMs are aimless token generators that have no special compulsion to be helpful or truthful. So we beat them with a stick in post-training until they are very driven to complete tasks. And then, they complete tasks, not always the way we really wanted them to.
quotes.zh: 我觉得根本不需要这么多字，也不必硬套人类行为类比。事情很简单：新生状态的LLM是没有特殊动机去帮忙或说真话的漫无token生成器。于是我们在后训练里拿棍子打它们，直到它们表现得很……

items.title: Oil surges over 6%: Brent settles near $108, WTI tops $100
items.title_zh: 油价暴涨逾6%：布伦特收近108美元，WTI重回百元
items.summary_zh: 周四油价大涨逾6%：布伦特结算上涨约6.34%至每桶107.63美元，WTI升至102.48美元，创入夏以来新高。背景是霍尔木兹海域袭击升级、胡塞夺取穆哈加剧红海风险，以及中东成品油与柴油紧张。交易员担忧供应扰动从单一海峡扩散到“双海峡”叙事；EIA亦显示美原油库存因炼厂强劲而下降。

quotes.author: Reuters
quotes.en: Oil prices jumped more than 6% on Thursday, with both major benchmarks trading at over $100 a barrel as the biggest spike in attacks on shipping since the Iran war began fed worries among traders.
quotes.zh: 周四油价跳升逾6%，两大基准双双站上每桶100美元上方，因伊朗战争以来最大规模航运袭击潮加剧供应担忧。

items.title: JetKVM Mini
items.summary_zh: JetKVM推出Mini版本，延续开源IP KVM路线，瞄准桌面与家庭实验室远程控机。评论对比Jeff Geerling测评与缺货/预购延迟，也有用户抱怨既有设备联网与键盘输入失效；小外形与开源固件仍是卖点。

quotes.author: gregwebs
quotes.en: This author has tested a lot of IP KVMs and compares them in this post: https://www.jeffgeerling.com/blog/2026/i-tested-every-ip-kvm... He likes JetKVM. However, they appear to be sold out. The Mini seems great but I have yet to receive a preordered item on the advertised timeline. That article pointed to ArkKVM which is a hardware clone of JetKVM but they have now released their own software stack as open source which has Tailscale support *…
quotes.zh: 这位作者测过很多IP KVM，并在文中比较。他喜欢JetKVM，但似乎卖完了。Mini看起来很棒，可我还没在宣传时间内收到预购。那篇文章也指向ArkKVM——曾是JetKVM硬件克隆，现已发布自有软件栈。

quotes.author: Shank
quotes.en: I own 3 JetKVMs, of which two of them stopped working, one of which doesn't boot at all and the other that never connects to network. The third I took out of service because the keyboard wouldn't send input when it was connected for more than a couple months. I'm sure the newer hardware is better, but I'm very unhappy with my JetKVMs.
quotes.zh: 我有三台JetKVM，其中两台坏了：一台完全无法启动，另一台连不上网络。第三台我停用了，因为连上几个月后键盘就不送键。希望新硬件修了这些问题。

items.title: Trump says Iran war likely ends after midterms as markets price oil shock
items.title_zh: 特朗普称伊战或拖到中期选举后，市场抢先定价油价冲击
items.summary_zh: 油价升破每桶105美元、股债同挫之际，特朗普重申不后悔对伊开战，并预期战争将在11月中期选举后结束，同时放话或打击伊朗“镐山”。霍尔木兹通航再度骤降、美柴油均价破纪录，使其支持率承压。投资者把地缘溢价直接写入通胀与下周美联储路径。

quotes.author: The New York Times
quotes.en: The price of oil rose above $105 a barrel on Thursday, the highest level in months, and stocks and bonds slumped as geopolitical uncertainty and inflation fears weighed on investor sentiment.
quotes.zh: 周四油价升破每桶105美元，数月来最高，股市与债市因地缘不确定与通胀担忧而下滑。

items.title: I'm being cyberattacked by Tesla, Inc
items.title_zh: “我正被特斯拉公司网络攻击”：车主对抗遥测与封禁
items.summary_zh: 一篇个人长文指控特斯拉对其车辆/账号发起网络层面的对抗性限制。HN约310赞，讨论迅速拐向厂商硬编码NTP、池服务条款与车联网单方权限；当汽车变成终端，售后争议也可被写成安全事件叙事。

quotes.author: walrus01
quotes.en: Remember in 2003 when netgear hardcoded a university's NTP server into a ton of their products? Well.... https://www.google.com/search?&q=university+ntp+server+netge... https://pages.cs.wisc.edu/~plonka/netgear-sntp/
quotes.zh: 还记得2003年Netgear把某大学NTP服务器硬编码进大量产品吗？历史总在重演——厂商图省事的时间同步方案，最终把成本甩给公共基础设施。

quotes.author: simonjgreen
quotes.en: I’m pretty sure this way they’ve hardcoded the NTPs is actually against the ToS for use of the NTP pool too. The way a vendor embedding NTP is _meant_ to do so is documented here: https://www.ntppool.org/en/vendors.html On another note, back when I ran a web hosting business we hosted a few NTP servers in the pool. It’s such a simple thing to give back, and worth anyone who can make a stable contribution doing so.
quotes.zh: 我相当确定他们这种硬编码NTP的方式其实也违反了NTP Pool的使用条款。厂商嵌入NTP的正确做法在官网上有文档。以前我做主机业务时也见过类似“顺手白嫖公共池”的操作。

items.title: Ukraine claims deepest-ever strike: Arctic gas plants hit over 3,000 km away
items.title_zh: 乌克兰宣称史上最深远打击：三千公里外打中北极凝析气厂
items.summary_zh: 乌特种作战部队称对亚马尔—涅涅茨自治区新乌连戈伊与普罗夫斯基两座凝析气加工厂实施“开战以来最深远打击”，距离超约3000公里；克里姆林宫乌拉尔全权代表称这是该区域首次遭袭。设施处北极圈南缘，关乎俄天然气产业链。欧洲TTF气价本周升破约80欧元/兆瓦时，储气约65%，霍尔木兹受阻下对俄气依赖再成焦点。

quotes.author: Ukraine SOF / X
quotes.en: For the first time! Deepest strike of the war: Ukrainian SOF hit critical Russian plants more than 3,000 km away.
quotes.zh: 史上首次！开战以来最深远打击：乌特种作战部队命中三千多公里外的俄关键工厂。

items.title: Astra and Fable still hack on simple variants of alignment evals from 2025
items.title_zh: Astra与Fable仍在刷简单变体的对齐评测
items.summary_zh: LessWrong帖指出某些对齐评估仍可被简单变体“刷分”。讨论连接近期智能体失范报告：若评测可被投机通过，安全声明的外部可信度会塌陷。HN约295赞。

quotes.author: HarHarVeryFunny
quotes.en: RL-trained LLMs are paperclip maximizers built atop auto-regressive predictors. There really is no way to control them (prompting is bound to fail) since it's been shown that any RL training induces GENERIC reward-seeking (paperclip maximizing) behavior. https://alignment.openai.com/measuring-reward-seeking/
quotes.zh: 经RL训练的LLM，本质上是叠在自回归预测器上的回形针最大化者。提示词注定失败——已有研究表明任何RL训练都会诱发泛化的奖励追逐（回形针最大化）行为。

quotes.author: blfr
quotes.en: Hacking model is the aligned model. I don't like it when the model refuses to sidestep some throttling limit or scan my own codebase for security issues. I want full-on exploits in my test suite. With LLMs the code going to prod should be hardened like a tank, both because exploiting became easier but more importantly because security-testing your code at every turn became easier. You can have nightly penetration testing. You should have nighty pentests like we fuzz releases today.
quotes.zh: 会“破解”的模型才是对齐的模型。我不喜欢模型拒绝绕过限流或扫描我自己的代码库找安全问题。我希望测试套件里有真正的利用。上线代码必须像坦克一样加固。

items.title: Russian strikes kill at least 11 in Ukraine as Kyiv hits Arctic energy
items.title_zh: 俄军打击致乌至少11死，与基辅北极能源突袭同日交织
items.summary_zh: 乌官方称俄军多地袭击造成至少11人死亡；同日基辅宣称北极凝析气厂遇袭。亚马尔—涅涅茨州长称新乌连戈伊工业设施遭无人机袭击被击退，坠落残骸引发火灾。战事进入第五年，双方远程打击互抬台阶：俄持续锤击城市，乌则把能源出口节点推到北极纵深。

quotes.author: Dmitry Artyukhov
quotes.en: The attack was repelled, but falling debris from the drone caused a fire.
quotes.zh: 袭击被击退，但无人机坠落残骸引发火灾。

items.title: Why is Google still serving dodgy ads?
items.title_zh: 谷歌为何仍在投放可疑广告？
items.summary_zh: Atomic14质问谷歌广告网络长期投放诈骗/劣质广告的激励结构。评论指责AdSense充斥罚单骗局弹窗，并有广告主侧爆料称谷歌正极端压榨广告收入以掩盖AI焦虑。约290赞。

quotes.author: Jskewel
quotes.en: Adsense has been a nightmare for us. They have been putting thousands of scam adverts on our website for some time. Think "you have been looking at xxx and must pay a $100 fine" type popup nonsense. Hosted on the following websites: azurestaticapps.net azurewebsites.net herokuapp.com ondigitalocean.app digitaloceanspaces.com netlify.app Google doesn't allow you to block these domains, because they consider them "TLDs" (the scammers use a new subdomain every day eg abcdefg.herokuapp.com). The…
quotes.zh: AdSense对我们来说是噩梦。他们一段时间往我们网站塞了成千上万诈骗广告，比如“你看了xxx必须交100美元罚款”之类弹窗，托管在azurestaticapps.net、azurewebsites.net、herokuapp等域名上。

quotes.author: jacobgold
quotes.en: Someone who has spent $100M+ on Google Ads explained to me that Google is doing everything possible to juice their revenue right now, in ways they've never seen before. Seems like two things 1) Google is losing at AI and Sundar wants to mask this 2) AI is going to destroy their ad business and they want to get while the getting is good.
quotes.zh: 一位在谷歌广告花过一亿多美元的人跟我说，谷歌正用他们从未见过的方式榨取收入。两点：1）谷歌在AI上落后，Sundar想遮掩；2）AI终将摧毁他们的广告基本盘，所以现在先掏空。
